title: Global shifted-energy context obstruction for local tensor-product Gibbs members
question: Can the four global-K D-weighted contexts be uniformly bounded for a local observable solely from bounded local data as remote Gibbs tensor factors grow?

model.gibbs_state: rho_n proportional to exp(-beta H_n), with exp(-beta remote_gap)=gibbs_excited_weight_ratio
model.interpretation: A global total-energy weight sees remote thermal energy even when D is strictly local; volume-uniform context control therefore requires a centered or local energy weight.

adversarial_review.check: The witness is an exactly solvable tensor-product Gibbs family, not the interacting Q3 Hamiltonian; it is used only to reject a topology-independent global-K shortcut.
D_n acts on the local factor and is identity on every remote factor; the growth comes only from the right energy index in K_n.
The remote binomial weights are derived from the declared excited-weight ratio; no probability or context coefficient is hardcoded.
The quadratic lower bound is exact for every nonnegative remote-site count; finite samples illustrate it and do not replace the bound.
The result selects a local/centered energy-weighted target but proves no interacting Q3 common-alpha, OS/KMS/GNS, gap, continuum, C6, Sector A or Pre-A theorem.

lean_crosscheck.boundary: Lean checks the exact rational fixture, polynomial lower bound and threshold implication; it does not formalize Gibbs operator domains or interacting Q3 dynamics.

qft_interface.closed: The global-total-energy four-context topology has an exact tensor-product quadratic growth obstruction for strictly local D.
qft_interface.open: The surviving target is a centered/local state-weighted D,delta-D estimate built on the source-uniform local-energy cone; interacting Q3 modular transfer, product/core density, exhaustion, common alpha, OS/KMS/GNS identification, gap, continuum and Pre-A remain open.
qft_interface.tect_boundary: No heat_root_incidence or canonical A1/R-192 production owner is supplied.

no_overclaim: This route-local product obstruction does not refute actual interacting Q3 dynamics and does not prove any QFT or Clay conclusion. It only rules out using a global shifted total-energy context as a volume-uniform local bound without additional centering or locality structure.
